You’re shock and confused right now and decided to ask the weird looking guy.*

Who are you? *You ask him*

M-master it’s me haru *He walks up to you and hug you*

What do you mean you’re haru? *You ask him still confused*

*Your friend shouted from the living room* Hey is everything okay there? 

Yeah don’t worry and don’t go upstairs and just make yourself at home *You shouted back to him so he can hear it*

Okay then *He shouted back*

*You ask the weird looking guy again* So what do you mean you’re haru?

S-see master when you go to your work i’m still s-sleeping r-right? And when i woke up i just turned into this but still have my cat ears and my tail.

I can’t believe this right now *You said pacing back and forth*

M-master it’s me trust me *He said softly*

Yeah sure okay that’s you oh wait you’re still naked wait here okay i’ll just grab my clothes and gave it to you *You said*

O-okay master *He said standing there and waiting for you*

*You head to your closet and find some sweater and pants that could fit him and go back to him*

Here go to the bathroom and put this on *You said giving the clothes to him*

Thankyou master i appreciate it *He said and goes to the bathroom*

*You waited patiently to him and after a while he got out of the bathroom*

That suits you well *You said smiling*

Thank you master i like it it’s comfortable *He said as he approached you and kiss your cheek*

O-oh haha no worries *You said blushing on what just he did*

Well i need to go back downstairs don’t make a noise or don’t go out of this room got it? *You said as you pat his head*

*He purrs to you patting his head and he nods* Okay master 

*I got of the room and head back downstairs where i leave my friend*

Hey vic do you want to watch a movie? I’ll make a snack while you search for some movies! Make sure it’s horror we both love horror movies. *You said*

Yeah sure go ahead *He said smiling to you*

*You head to the kitchen to prepare a snack for the both of you and after that you head back to the living room and sat down to watch the movie with him*

*After the movie ends vic went home and i head upstairs and go to my room and see haru sitting on the bed with angry, lustful eyes*

Did you enjoy that movie with him *He stands up and walk over to you and he pin you to the wall and grab both of your arms and pin it on top of your head and he kisses you well you enjoy the kiss*

*You switch your positions and now you’re pinning him and dominating him*
